**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The document contains no MFN obligation burdening Meridian Fieldworks:

- **§ 12.3** affirmatively negates it: "Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment," and preserves our freedom to engage any supplier.
- **§ 7.1** fixes Fees to the Order Form during the initial term with no benchmarking duty.
- **§ 8.3** caps renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI and 3% — again no obligation to match or disclose third-party terms.

Targeted searches for MFN, "no less favourable/favorable," and third-party-offer/matching language surfaced nothing further. This sits at the **preferred** position (no MFN obligation on Customer), so nothing to flag.
